about: Hand-entered facts about headliner cards that Scryfall and TCGplayer don't give. Keys are lowercase: a set code under sets, set/collector number under cards. Check every fact against a source and list the source. tools/build_headliners.py copies these into docs/data/headliners.json.

trk.title: Star Trek signed cards
trk.summary: 7 cards. Each was printed, hand-signed by a Star Trek actor and randomly put into a Collector Booster. Scryfall's pictures show the blank signature box.
trk.run: Fewer than 250 copies of each card
trk.odds: Not published. Wizards says only that one appears in "an extremely low quantity of Collector Boosters".
trk.language: Found in Collector Boosters of any language; the card is always in English.
trk.notice: Unofficial fan app. Not made or endorsed by Wizards of the Coast or Paramount.
